title: ClientAnonymized v1 payload
description: Published by identity when staff complete a rider's deletion request and the client is anonymized (REQ-RID-10, REQ-PRV-04, section 36.4). Aggregate Client. Each module removes the rider's personal data it owns: notification the push devices and pending notifications, geo the address-search log, payments the saved cards and their tokens. Orders, the journal, ratings and the audit log stay (AC-24). Consumers are idempotent.
